data.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
data.detailed_description:
28 Days Train Wreck Survivor

After a freight train crash, you find yourself trapped among twisted metal and shattered cars, pinned between snow-covered cliffs.

There’s no help nearby.

You have 28 days to explore the wreck site, find resources, gather food, craft essential gear, and prepare for the catastrophic storm that’s drawing closer.

Each day gets colder.

Can you survive all 28 days?

EXPLORE THE FREIGHT TRAIN

Search through wrecked freight cars for food, tools, clothing, medicine, and materials.

Some cars are locked. In others, you’ll find only parts of the equipment you need—so you’ll have to hunt for missing pieces and use whatever you manage to salvage.

Not every container will be useful: lockers, crates, and bags can be empty—or hold several items at once.

GATHER RESOURCES AND CRAFT GEAR

Hunt animals, pick mushrooms and berries, collect firewood, and keep the fire going.

Use the materials you find to craft tools, weapons, and other essential equipment.

Sew clothing to better withstand the intensifying cold.

THE COLD GETS WORSE WITH EACH DAY

The first days give you time to prepare, but conditions gradually become harsher.

With each new day, the temperature drops, the weather grows more dangerous, and venturing far from safety becomes increasingly risky.

Keep an eye on hunger, thirst, fatigue, warmth, and health.

Decide when it’s worth going out for resources—and when it’s better to stay safe and prepare for the next day.

SURVIVE AMONG PREDATORS

The wilderness is no less dangerous than the cold.

While exploring, you may come face to face with deadly predators. A single encounter can turn an ordinary supply run into a fight for survival.

Craft weapons, defend yourself, and decide when to stand your ground—and when to avoid a confrontation.

FEATURES

  • A huge wrecked freight train with cars you can explore.

  • Locked cars that require you to find and craft the right tools to access.

  • Resource containers that may be empty—or hold useful items.

  • Hunger, thirst, fatigue, warmth, and health that you must constantly manage.

  • A steady temperature drop with each new day.

  • Hunting and encounters with dangerous predators.

  • Gathering mushrooms, berries, firewood, and other resources.

  • Starting and keeping a fire going.

  • Crafting tools, weapons, and other essential gear.

  • Sewing clothing to protect yourself from the worsening cold.

  • Cooking food and drinks.

  • Limited resources that force you to plan every trip and decide what risks are worth taking.

data.short_description: A hardcore first-person survival simulator. Explore a wrecked freight train, loot containers, hunt, gather resources, craft weapons and gear, and manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, and warmth to make it through 28 days of cold and predators.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: AMD R5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 MB available space

  • Processor: AMD R5 3600X or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
